run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T02:06:25Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is backed by frontend's own error spans: from 02:06:25Z the frontend recorded STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on POST, POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and the client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, at about 0.10 spans/s at 02:06:25Z rising to 0.39-0.43 spans/s through 02:14:25Z. The same requests error in checkout ('HTTP POST', oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) and, one hop deeper, in shipping ('POST quote', SPAN_KIND_CLIENT, plus its server span '/get-quote'). Shipping's client span to quote is the deepest failing call observed, and quote's own total span rate collapsed from 3.3-4.8 spans/s (02:01-02:05Z) to 0.2-1.1 spans/s (02:06-02:14Z samples) with no error spans of its own, i.e. its traffic was cut off rather than failing. Chaos-mesh events show a Schedule named otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition in namespace chaos-mesh spawning a NetworkChaos experiment roughly every minute from 02:04:27Z (last visible start 02:14:27Z), each applying chaos to otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 and both quote pods and recovering it about 55s later; the error burst begins in the 02:05:00-02:06:00Z minute and the error counters stop increasing after the last experiment. The conclusion is partial because the Schedule/NetworkChaos objects themselves could not be read (only their events), no trace-level error text was retrievable, the RequestErrorRate rule definition was unavailable, and change_history is not integrated, so the attribution rests on events plus metric timing.

claims.text: Frontend service recorded STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rates starting at 02:06:25Z: span 'POST' and 'POST /api/checkout' at 0.102 spans/s at 02:06:25Z, rising to 0.326-0.419 spans/s from 02:08:25Z to 02:14:25Z and 0.125 spans/s by 02:19:25Z; the same error rate appears on 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and on the client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, while frontend's other operations (GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, GET /api/products/{productId}, GET /api/recommendations) show error rate 0 throughout.

The frontend span counter for span 'POST /api/checkout' with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR was flat at 44 from 01:50:00Z to 02:05:00Z, then rose to 71 (02:06:00Z), 237 (02:12:00Z) and 323 (02:15:00Z), staying at 323 through 02:20:00Z - 279 new error spans in a burst starting in the 02:05:00-02:06:00Z minute and ending between 02:15:00Z and 02:16:00Z.
Shipping's span counter for span '/get-quote' with STATUS_CODE_ERROR first appears at 27 at 02:06:00Z, increases by about 24-35 per minute to 279 at 02:15:00Z, and stays at 279 through 02:20:00Z.

Checkout (span 'HTTP POST' and 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder') and shipping (span '/get-quote' and 'POST quote') show identical STATUS_CODE_ERROR rates from the first non-zero sample: 0.1209, 0.3284, 0.4185, 0.4, 0.4185, 0.2393 and 0 spans/s by 02:19:25Z, indicating the same failing requests propagate from shipping through checkout.

At 02:12:00Z the 5-minute increase of STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans was 155.56 for each of these series: frontend 'POST /api/checkout', 'POST', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder'; frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'; checkout 'HTTP POST' and 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder'; shipping 'POST quote' and '/get-quote'. No error series was returned for payment, email, currency, cart, product-catalog, recommendation or quote at that instant (ad 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' showed an unrelated 1.11 increase).

Shipping's two error series are span_name 'POST quote' with span_kind SPAN_KIND_CLIENT and span_name '/get-quote' with span_kind SPAN_KIND_SERVER, both status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR; the failing outbound call is shipping's call to quote, with the corresponding shipping server span.

Quote's total span rate (all statuses) fell from 3.5, 2.5, 3.9, 4.8 and 3.3 spans/s at 02:01:00-02:05:00Z to 0.6, 0.6, 0.2, 0.3, 1.1, 0.6, 0.7 and 0.6 spans/s for the samples between 02:06:00Z and 02:14:00Z (some minutes missing), while quote produced no STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans.

Chaos-mesh events show Schedule 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition' in namespace chaos-mesh spawning a NetworkChaos object about every minute: 'Experiment has started' at 02:04:27Z, 02:05:27Z, 02:06:27Z and so on through 02:14:27Z, each followed about 55s later by 'Time up according to the duration' (for example 02:05:22Z, 02:06:22Z through 02:14:22Z), with matching 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9', 'otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt' and 'otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b' and later 'Successfully recover chaos' records.

The earliest chaos experiment in the window, NetworkChaos otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-nh2wt, started at 02:04:27Z, applied chaos to otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 and the two quote pods, timed up at 02:05:22Z and reported 'Successfully recover chaos' for all three pods; the Schedule 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition' spawned it.

Cluster-wide event grouping showed 33 NetworkChaos 'Applied', 30 'Recovered', 11 'Started', 10 'TimeUp' and 126 'Updated' events in chaos-mesh plus 63 PodNetworkChaos 'Updated' events on named quote and shipping pods in otel-demo; no Evicted, OOMKilled, BackOff, Failed or Unhealthy events appeared for otel-demo workloads, the data-recorders events being Job, StatefulSet and PVC activity in namespace data-recorders.

Shipping pod shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 logs between 02:13:24Z and 02:14:55Z show repeated 'Requesting quote' lines with no 'Sending Quote' during the partition interval 02:13:28Z-02:14:21Z, then a burst of 'Sending Quote' lines at 02:14:22Z-02:14:26Z immediately after the corresponding NetworkChaos recovery; that filtered view was marked incomplete by its 60-line limit.

All 22 otel-demo pods were Running and ready with restart count 0 and start times between 01:30:15Z and 01:32:15Z, including frontend-675fd7b5c5-d2vwq, checkout-5dccddf8bb-vz2zd, shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9, quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt and quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b; all 21 otel-demo deployments reported readyReplicas equal to availableReplicas and spec.replicas.

No NetworkPolicy objects exist in the cluster (the networking.k8s.io networkpolicies list returned zero items), and the quote Service had two ready endpoint addresses (100.96.2.155 and 100.96.4.53) with no unready addresses, so the shipping-to-quote failure is not explained by a NetworkPolicy or missing endpoint.

The flagd fault-injection ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (key demo.flagd.json) lists flags adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure, and every one has defaultVariant 'off' as read at query time; no shipping or quote fault flag exists in it.

The repeated network partition injected by Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition (chaos-mesh) between pod shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 and quote pods quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt and quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b is the cause: it makes shipping's client span 'POST quote' fail and shipping's server span '/get-quote' return an error, which checkout ('HTTP POST', oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) and frontend (POST /api/checkout) propagate, raising the RequestErrorRate alert. Support: error onset falls in the 02:05:00-02:06:00Z minute right after the first experiment started at 02:04:27Z; error counters stop increasing after the last visible experiment; quote's span rate collapses exactly during the partition minutes while quote emits no errors; shipping's logs show 'Requesting quote' waiting followed by 'Sending Quote' bursts right after each recovery. Not directly verifiable: the Schedule and NetworkChaos specs could not be read and no trace error text was available.

Entities observed with their own error evidence tied to this chain: frontend (error spans POST, POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder), frontend-proxy (error spans 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'), checkout (error spans 'HTTP POST', 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder') and shipping (error spans 'POST quote' client span and '/get-quote' server span), each at 155.56 error spans per 5 minutes at 02:12:00Z.

Rejected as the cause of this burst: a fault-injection flag in otel-demo/flagd-config (for example paymentFailure, cartFailure or adFailure) being switched on. Every flag's defaultVariant was 'off' when read, and the errors are confined to the shipping-to-quote path rather than payment, cart or ad operations. Caveat: the ConfigMap values during 02:00-02:15Z were not observable, since objects show only current state.

Rejected: a pod-level failure of shipping or quote (crash, OOM, eviction, readiness loss) as the trigger. All otel-demo pods were Running and ready with 0 restarts and start times before the incident window, both quote pods were running, the quote Service had two ready endpoints, and no Warning-type pod events or Unhealthy events appeared in otel-demo.

Have the platform owner inspect the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition and the NetworkChaos objects it spawns in namespace chaos-mesh, confirm its target selector, direction and duration, and stop or delete the schedule if the shipping-to-quote partition is unintended; these chaos CRD objects are not readable with the permitted tools, so a cluster-side read is needed.

gaps: Chaos-mesh objects (kind Schedule, NetworkChaos, PodNetworkChaos) could not be read with the permitted Kubernetes kinds, so their specs (selector, direction, duration, whether the schedule is still enabled) are unknown; the Schedule is known only from its events, which end at 02:14:27Z.

The Jaeger trace search for service frontend over 02:00:00-02:22:14Z returned no_data and the tag search service shipping with error=true over 02:00:00-02:16:00Z returned no_data, so no trace id, span error message or verified parent-child reference was obtained; the call chain is inferred from span names and kinds plus matching error rates.

The frontend pod log query returned 0 lines read, and error-filtered log queries on shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9, quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt and checkout-5dccddf8bb-vz2zd returned no_data (only 'Requesting quote' and 'Sending Quote' informational lines matched in shipping), so no application-level error text or status code confirms the exact failure mode.

The chaos-mesh ConfigMap query for otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition returned no_data and list_prometheus_rules returned no rules at all (both for the named rule and unfiltered), so the RequestErrorRate expression, threshold and evaluation interval are unknown and the annotation value 1.1111 was not reproduced from a rule.
The change_history integration is not available, so who or what created or enabled the chaos Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition, and when, cannot be determined.

The exact end of the error burst (between 02:15:00Z and 02:16:00Z) is inferred only from error counters staying flat at 323 (frontend) and 279 (shipping); chaos events after 02:14:27Z and pod logs after about 02:14:55Z were not available.
Only sampled series were used (1-minute and 5-minute steps); the counter's first non-zero sample at 02:06:00Z leaves the exact first failing request time within 02:05:00-02:06:00Z unknown.
next_steps: Read the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition spec with sufficient RBAC (for example kubectl get schedule -n chaos-mesh -o yaml) to confirm target, direction and duration and whether it is still active.

Confirm with the platform or chaos owner whether the shipping-quote network partition is intentional test traffic; if not, pause the Schedule and verify that shipping '/get-quote' error spans and frontend POST /api/checkout errors stop.
Collect checkout and shipping error logs, or enable debug logging, to capture the exact failure mode of the quote call (connection reset or timeout versus HTTP status) for the 02:05-02:15Z window.
Check the Alertmanager and Prometheus rule definition for RequestErrorRate to confirm which metric and threshold produced the reported current value of 1.1111.
